_doc: Sand Creek Raceway through the Lake Murray chain (tools/ship_track.sh; Kevin 2026-10-28: 'rebuild all four with the Lake Murray chain'). The draft is the engine's own on the KML route over the real streets (source.type kml: gps -> elev -> project -> widths (osm_road_widths) -> mesh), then the underlay drops data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_* collections (scripts/blender/underlay.py). Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*), the prep / exporter run from airoso's scripts/ac, the four gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso.
_owed: First pass = the 'full' layout's draft through the chain. The reverse layout is parked in track.config.json _layouts_v3_owed until its start is declared on the V3 centreline (layouts[].start -> tools/layout_dummies.py -> a spawn kn5; then steps.author gains layout_dummies and steps.ship gains spawn_kn5). No signs, lamps, race furniture or TreeFX yet. The Colorado rebuild session's NAIP width (10.5 m on the straights, 2026-10-28) is on the Mac, not committed: carry it into width_overrides before the draft runs.
